verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser lets engineers mix programmatic Playwright/Puppeteer control with AI steps through HyperAgent (`page.ai`, `page.extract` with Zod schemas) and SDKs. That means repeatable multi-step workflows with loops, conditionals and parameters can be written in ordinary code rather than as one-shot prompts. The docs, though, describe agent tasks as single API calls and never show a dedicated workflow-composition feature. Missing for 10: a first-class workflow or template construct with documented parameters, loops or conditionals, a saved and re-runnable workflow definition, and independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-step workflow composition.
